PAGE TITLE: HERSTORY
NASA Johnson Dedicates Building to Dorothy Vaughan, Women of Apollo

PHOTOS: A portrait of Dorothy Vaughan.

KEY FACTS:
- NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston recognized legendary human computer Dorothy Vaughan and the women of Apollo with activities celebrating their achievements on Friday, July 19.
- The event was held on the eve of the 55th anniversary of the Apollo 11 Moon landing.
- NASA Johnson Director Vanessa Wyche began with a discussion about the importance of Vaughan and the women of Apollo’s contributions and their significance to today’s Artemis campaign.
- Building 12 was renamed the "Dorothy Vaughan Center in Honor of the Women of Apollo."
